transactionbodycustomfield.description: The RELEASE LEDGER - JSON, maintained by the RapidBridge inbound write RESTlet (§11.6). It records what this receipt received per lot and how much of it each inventory_release call has moved out of the on-hold bin, so a repeat call cannot move the same stock twice. IT IS THE AUTHORITY ON WHAT MAY STILL BE RELEASED - do not edit it by hand except to repair a known discrepancy, and never clear it. Neither of the obvious alternatives works: request_uuid in the external id catches a resend of the SAME call but not a retry carrying a fresh one, and the on-hold bin's balance is shared between receipts and lags, because it is a search index. Shape: { v, receipt, seq, updated, lots: { "item|lot": { item, lot, lotId, received, released } }, calls: [ { uuid, bt, at, moved: [ { k, q } ] } ], callCount }. The per-lot totals are never trimmed; the calls array keeps the most recent 50, because the full history is in the Sync Log.
